name: F3b.2 the settings page lists loke's privacy layers as loke's GET /api/privacylayers gives them, in run order, with the regex layer's switch locked on
js: await (async()=>{await window.loadPrivacyLayers();const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacylayers',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const rows=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#pl-layers .pl-row'));const bad=d.layers.filter((l,i)=>{const r=rows[i];return !r||r.dataset.layer!==l.id||r.querySelector('.pl-enabled').checked!==l.enabled||Number(r.querySelector('.pl-priority').value)!==l.priority||r.querySelector('.pl-mode').value!==l.mode;}).map(l=>l.id);const rx=document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="regex"] .pl-enabled');return (d.layers.length>=4&&rows.length===d.layers.length&&bad.length===0&&rx.disabled&&rx.checked&&document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="regex"] .pl-mode option[value="detect-only"]').disabled&&/always runs/.test(document.getElementById('pl-regex-rule').textContent))||JSON.stringify({bad,rows:rows.length,n:d.layers.length});})()

name: F3b.2 a change saved on the page reaches loke's config.toml: GET then reports presidio at priority 0 in veto mode, and the page says it was saved
js: await (async()=>{const r=document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="presidio"]');r.querySelector('.pl-priority').value='0';r.querySelector('.pl-mode').value='veto';await window.savePrivacyLayers();const st=document.getElementById('pl-status').textContent;const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacylayers',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const p=d.layers.find(l=>l.id==='presidio');const first=document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row').dataset.layer;return (st==='Saved to config.toml.'&&p.priority===0&&p.mode==='veto'&&first==='presidio')||JSON.stringify({st,p,first});})()

name: F3b.2 switching the regex layer off is refused by loke (its switch forced open in the page), the page shows loke's refusal, and regex stays on
js: await (async()=>{const b=document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="regex"] .pl-enabled');b.disabled=false;b.checked=false;await window.savePrivacyLayers();const st=document.getElementById('pl-status').textContent;const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacylayers',{cache:'no-store'})).json();return (/^Not saved: not saved: enabled = false is not applied to the regex layer/.test(st)&&/open decision/.test(st)&&d.layers.find(l=>l.id==='regex').enabled===true)||JSON.stringify({st});})()

name: F3b.2 an organisation policy's floor is shown and its switches locked (loke's answer replaced in the page by a canned policy, since a browser cannot write loke.policy.json)
js: await (async()=>{const real=window.fetch;const d=await (await real('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacylayers',{cache:'no-store'})).json();d.policy={present:true,enforced:true,error:'',minimum_layers:2,required_layers:['presidio'],banned_layers:['openai-privacy-filter'],max_confidence_threshold:'0.6',locked_consensus:''};d.layers.forEach(l=>{l.policy_required=l.id==='presidio';l.policy_banned=l.id==='openai-privacy-filter';});window.fetch=()=>Promise.resolve(new Response(JSON.stringify(d),{status:200,headers:{'Content-Type':'application/json'}}));try{await window.loadPrivacyLayers();}finally{window.fetch=real;}const row=id=>document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="'+id+'"]');const pr=row('presidio'),pf=row('openai-privacy-filter');const t=document.getElementById('pl-policy');const ok=!t.hidden&&/required: presidio/.test(t.textContent)&&/banned: openai-privacy-filter/.test(t.textContent)&&/at most 0.6/.test(t.textContent)&&pr.querySelector('.pl-enabled').disabled&&pr.querySelector('.pl-enabled').checked&&pr.querySelector('.pl-mode option[value="detect-only"]').disabled&&pf.querySelector('.pl-enabled').disabled&&!pf.querySelector('.pl-enabled').checked&&pr.querySelector('.pl-threshold').max==='0.6';await window.loadPrivacyLayers();return ok||JSON.stringify({t:t.textContent});})()

name: F3b.7 the models panel registers a model through loke's /api/privacymodels and lists it, and the layers editor then shows it as a layer
F3b.7 a label mapped to a type loke does not know is refused by loke, and the page shows why
js: await (async()=>{document.getElementById('pm-id').value='ui-check/bad';document.getElementById('pm-labels').value='X=NOT_A_TYPE';await window.addPrivacyModel();const st=document.getElementById('pm-status').textContent;const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacymodels',{cache:'no-store'})).json();return (/^Not registered: /.test(st)&&/not an entity type loke knows/.test(st)&&!d.models.some(x=>x.id==='ui-check/bad'))||JSON.stringify({st});})()

name: F3b.7 Edit puts a registered model's values in the form, and registering it again replaces it in loke: GET then reports the new threshold and priority, still one registration
js: await (async()=>{await window.loadPrivacyModels();const row=document.querySelector('#pm-models .pm-row[data-layer="model:ui-check/ner"]');row.querySelector('.pm-edit').click();const f=id=>document.getElementById(id);const filled=f('pm-id').value==='ui-check/ner'&&f('pm-url').value==='http://127.0.0.1:9'&&f('pm-labels').value==='PER=PERSON, LOC=LOCATION'&&f('pm-enabled').checked===false&&/^Editing model:ui-check\/ner/.test(f('pm-status').textContent);f('pm-threshold').value='0.4';f('pm-priority').value='8';await window.addPrivacyModel();const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacymodels',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const ms=d.models.filter(x=>x.id==='ui-check/ner');return (filled&&ms.length===1&&ms[0].confidence_threshold==='0.4'&&ms[0].priority===8&&ms[0].enabled===false)||JSON.stringify({filled,ms});})()

name: F3b.7 Remove asks again before it acts; the second click removes the model in loke, and the panel and the layers editor no longer show it
js: await (async()=>{const q=()=>document.querySelector('#pm-models .pm-row[data-layer="model:ui-check/ner"]');const b=q().querySelector('.pm-remove');b.click();const armed=b.textContent==='Confirm remove';const still=(await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacymodels',{cache:'no-store'})).json()).models.some(x=>x.id==='ui-check/ner');b.click();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,1500));const st=document.getElementById('pm-status').textContent;const d=await (await fetch('http://127.0.0.1:11430/api/privacymodels',{cache:'no-store'})).json();const lay=document.querySelector('#pl-layers .pl-row[data-layer="model:ui-check/ner"]');return (armed&&still&&st==='Removed model:ui-check/ner.'&&!d.models.some(x=>x.id==='ui-check/ner')&&!q()&&!lay)||JSON.stringify({armed,still,st,row:!!q(),lay:!!lay});})()
